title: 도시재정비 촉진을 위한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text: Article 2 (Reporting Designation of Urban Renewal Promotion Districts, etc.) Where the Mayor of a Special Metropolitan City, a Metropolitan City Mayor, a Do Governor, a Special Self-Governing Do Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor or Do Governor"), or the Mayor of a large city with a population of at least 500,000 excluding Seoul Special Metropolitan City and Metropolitan Cities under Article 175 of the Local Autonomy Act (hereinafter referred to as a "large city") designates or alters an urban renewal promotion district under Article 5 (6) of the Special Act on the Promotion of Urban Renewal (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), such Mayor or Governor shall report the matters specified in the subparagraphs of Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Promotion of Urban Renewal (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. <Amended on March 14, 2008; November 29, 2011; March 23, 2013>
